item.name: Stripe Webhook (called by Stripe, not the client)

exec: pm.test("Rejected without a genuine Stripe signature", function () {

request.description: This endpoint is called by Stripe’s servers, not by a Postman user. It verifies the Stripe-Signature header via the raw request body, so this example (an unsigned payload) is expected to fail with 400. Configure a real webhook in the Stripe Dashboard (or use the Stripe CLI: `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:5000/api/v1/payments/webhook`) to exercise it for real.
Targets the throwaway account created by "Register" in the Auth folder.
